_comment: Report reasons shown in Bird Buddies. id/label drive the menu and are all the base app needs. For the Coop integration, run the setup scripts (npm run setup:coop, setup:coop:queues, setup:coop:routing) — they create the matching Coop policies/queues/routing rules and fill policyId + queueId below. csam:true would route a report into Coop's NCMEC CyberTipline flow (requires NCMEC credentials in Coop); leave csam:false to route child-safety reports to a normal NCMEC Review queue instead.
